General.Name: Balkrishna Industries Limited
General.Description: Balkrishna Industries Limited manufactures and sells tires in India, Europe, North America, and internationally. It provides manufacturing and selling of off-highway tires OHT for use in various applications, such as agricultural, mining, forestry, construction, industrial, earthmoving, port, all-terrain vehicle ATV, and turf care applications. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
